page.title: Tools
page.description: Advanced utilities for sharing, syncing and verifying your encrypted vault. Everything runs end-to-end encrypted in your browser.

send.sizeError: File too large ({size}). Maximum is {max} for anonymous sends.
send.dailyLoginRequired: Daily limit reached. Log in to send more.
send.dailyLimit: You've reached today's limit. Try again tomorrow.
send.hint: Up to {max}. Files are encrypted in your browser before upload.
send.burnDesc: File is deleted after first download
send.info: Your file is encrypted in your browser before upload. The encryption key is embedded in the share link: the server never sees your data.
send.doneSubtitle: Share this link. The recipient can download and decrypt in their browser.

pad.placeholder: Type or paste your text here...
pad.burnDesc: Text is deleted after first view
pad.info: Your text is encrypted in your browser. The encryption key is embedded in the share link: the server stores only encrypted data.
pad.doneSubtitle: Share this link. Recipients can view the encrypted text in their browser.

transfer.info: Files are encrypted on the sending device with a key that never touches the server. It travels only in the QR code or link you share, or in the pairing key you read out. The server relays ciphertext and cannot read the file or its name, but it can see that a transfer happened and roughly how large it is.
transfer.confirmCode: Both screens must show the same confirmation code
transfer.selectHint: Select a file to send to another device
transfer.waitingHint: Scan the QR code or open the link on the receiving device, or type the code and pairing key there
transfer.pairingKeyLabel: Pairing key (skip if you scanned the QR code)
transfer.mismatch: Pairing key does not match the sender
transfer.integrityAlt: Transfer integrity check failed: the file was incomplete or altered

snapshots.takeDesc: Record a labelled list of what's in your vault right now. This is a manifest, not a backup. It can't restore files.
snapshots.emptyDesc: Take a snapshot to record which files are in your vault right now. It's a manifest you can review later, not a backup or restore point.
snapshots.confirmDesc: This permanently removes the snapshot. Your files are not affected. This cannot be undone.
snapshots.confirmDescNamed: This permanently removes the snapshot “{name}”. Your files are not affected. This cannot be undone.

integrity.changesDetected: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} with integrity changes detected
integrity.sectionDesc: Record a file's fingerprint, then check it later for tampering.
integrity.emptyDesc: Select a file above and take a snapshot to start tracking its integrity over time.

expiring.intro: Group files under a shared countdown. When it runs out the vault is flagged expired, your files stay put.
expiring.emptyDesc: Create one to group files under a countdown. When it expires the vault is flagged: the files themselves stay in your vault.
expiring.confirmDesc: This removes the vault and its timer. The files themselves are not deleted.
expiring.confirmDescNamed: This removes the vault “{name}” and its timer. The files themselves are not deleted.

devices.offlineDesc: Keep selected files available on this device without a connection.
devices.clipboardDesc: End-to-end encrypted snippets that sync across your devices. Items auto-delete after 24h.
devices.clipboardPlaceholder: Paste or type content to sync across devices...
devices.folderDesc: Folders a linked device backs up automatically.
devices.folderNote: Keep the desktop app open on each device to keep these folders in sync.
devices.confirmDesc: This stops syncing. Files already uploaded stay in your vault.
devices.confirmDescNamed: This stops syncing “{name}”. Files already uploaded stay in your vault.
